reasonSentences.not-a-symmetry: τ is not a symmetry of the board (it breaks the roads at nodes 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5).
reasonSentences.not-an-involution: τ applied twice is not the identity (nodes 1, 2 and 3).
reasonSentences.moves-black-set: τ sends black node 1 to a white node, so it does not keep the black set.
reasonSentences.differs-from-minus-wX: On the black node 1, τ differs from −w_X.
reasonSentences.not-an-integer: At node 2 the number ⟨α_2, ρ_X^∨⟩ is −1/2, which is not an integer. (Several nodes: At node 3 ... is −3/2 and at node 5 ... is −1/2, which are not integers.)
reasonSentences.failureNote: This decoration is not the Satake diagram of any real form, so the Studio shows no data for it. [When conditions 1 and 2 hold:] Conditions 1 and 2 hold, and θ = −w_X∘τ can still be played: it permutes the roots, and playing it twice gives back the root. But no involution of the Lie algebra acts as this θ on the Cartan subalgebra and fixes the root vectors of the black nodes.

announcementWording.paint: Node 1 painted black. Condition 1 holds, condition 2 holds, condition 3 fails. Not admissible.
announcementWording.tau: τ exchanges 1 and 3. Condition 1 holds, condition 2 holds, condition 3 holds. Admissible.
announcementWording.compositeMove: Played the composite move of restricted node 2, 32 mutations. Shadow coordinates now 0, minus 1.

workerUsage: satake, restrictedBoard and matchCatalogue go through engineCall with { board, kind: 'satake' } and are provided by name in t13/load.ts. They reach the worker on E7 and E8 only. satakeRecord is not called. admissibility, theta, shadow2, restrictedCoordinates, satakeCatalogue, canonicalPair and the rest stay on the main thread.
c2Rule: Each matched record gets the C2 adjustment on its own (display C2 and satake B2 give restricted board C2 and satake's Bourbaki orbits reversed). The board is drawn by the record whose black_nodes and tau equal the reader's pair, otherwise by the first record.
